name: Insolation Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Insolation Energy Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing solar panels and modules of high efficiency of various sizes. The company's 200 MW SPV Module manufacturing unit is located in Jaipur, spread over more than 60,000 Sq. ft area with the latest machinery.[1]
keyPoints:
Market Position
The company is the 2nd largest North Indian manufacturer of solar panels, batteries, and inverters based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. [1]

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 40.0%
cons: Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
